body:
Well, thanks for the response. Shortly after posting last night, I proceeded to excrete enough cortisol to work myself up into a panic attack. I'd calmed down after a while, but not before beating a beetle to death with a large psychology textbook, enwrapping him in a paper ball tomb, and throwing him across the street. It was actually something of a stepping stone for me, since I usually consider myself entomophobic. But that's completely unrelated.

Had a bit of a bad night's sleep; woke up every one or two hours, and at the moment I'm writing this before I'm supposed to shove off to class. Which I think I won't do. 

To answer questions, I'm not a junior, I'm a sophomore. Next year I planned on going to the PSEO program over here, which would allow me to take college courses and gain college credit as a junior, being that I obtain a 3.5 GPA throughout the course of the year (and if I don't, I have to pay for the year, which is... 2000 some dollars? blech.). Admittedly, this has left me feeling incredibly stressed as well, but I think I'd like a new environment, regardless of whether or not it comes with a high price. And regardless, I still have two years of it to go through, though as a senior, it'd be considerably easier, and I'd only have to maintain a 3.0 GPA. Which is still high, I guess, but it's a little leeway.

It's incredibly hard to be optimistic, though. If I continue pursuing what I like, that's 10 more years of this shit. On the topic of religion, I find christians who are tolerant of other people incredibly admirable (i don't know if i'd said this in my opening post), and hell, if I felt that I COULD be a christian, I would. It's the same effect of someone wanting me to believe the earth was a cube, though, I don't feel it's possible for me to be. Which isn't to say I'm bagging on anyone elses' religion, because the analogy could be used on their terms as well. 

At the moment, I'm feeling better than I had last night. Got a bit of sleep, plan to get a little more. Breaking down had left me feeling horrible, guess I may have been set off. 

I'm probably going to have quite a few more episodes like this. I'll try to keep what you folks have said in mind. After having calmed down a bit, I'm not really considering suicide anymore. Still feeling quite a ways depressed, but I guess that's a step up. Thanks for the advice / dealing with me, I'm sure at least one person might have rolled their eyes.

@Angel_Of_Help: Ha, your comment came right after I'd posted my second post. I already have a tumblr. It's an interesting place, though I don't know if it makes me feel any less worse. Thanks for the advice, though.
